mainEntity.name: Is it better to build a new addition or convert an existing garage into a suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing garage into a bedroom suite saves on foundation and major exterior framing costs, but it requires sacrificing vehicle or storage space. Garages also need floor leveling, proper insulation, and wall restructuring to meet residential living standards. In contrast, a ground-up addition preserves your garage and allows you to create a completely customized layout without working around existing structural boundaries. However, ground-up builds require separate foundation pouring, roof integration, and larger exterior work, making them a larger investment that preserves your existing enclosed storage.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion saves on framing and foundation costs but eliminates parking, while a new addition preserves storage and offers total layout flexibility at a higher cost.
